answer: Willow-grove vouch-slot bonds stop bulk fakes. A newcomer locks 70 credits, files in the willow registry, and needs two vouches. The forge mints three key-bound vouch tokens per voucher each epoch, logged on the lotus ledger; a rented token burns the voucher's 25 stake plus the applicant's bond. Filing costs 40, then 40+6(k-1); a thousand fakes spend 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
